candidates.claim: The effective CORP_IN permit at fw-01:60, bound to the corp interface at fw-01:103, lets CORP 192.168.30.0/24 open tcp/22 connections to MGMT 10.10.99.0/24, which is not an approved cross-zone service.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN tcp/22 permit to MGMT so that CORP reaches the OT side only through approved services.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the OT-side MGMT zone on tcp/22 is permitted at fw-01:60 but is not among the approved cross-zone services A1 to A7, so it bypasses DMZ mediation.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN tcp/22 permit to MGMT and route any required access through the jump host.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta shows the access-list CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 was added and is not present in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added CORP_IN entry with the approved baseline and remove it unless it is formally approved.
